sloka: तं श्रुत्वा समनुप्राप्तं रामं दशरथो नृपः ।प्रवेश्यामास गृहं विवक्षुः प्रियमुत्तमम् ॥२-४-९॥
transliteration: taṁ śrutvā samanuprāptaṁ rāmaṁ daśaratho nṛpaḥ ।praveśyāmāsa gṛhaṁ vivakṣuḥ priyamuttamam ॥2-4-9॥

translations.english: Having heard of Rama's arrival, king Dasaratha got him admitted into his apartment to tell him something very pleasant.
